answer: Each agent identity must lock collateral before it earns tasks or attestations. To run a Sybil farm the attacker funds one full bond per fake identity, so cost grows linearly with the number of fakes while reward stays flat. A slashing rule then burns the bond of any identity linked to another by shared funding or cloned behavior, leaving a thin ledge between profit and loss. Honest capital stays liquid and flows on like a river, but a swarm of ember accounts watches its stake burn faster than it can earn.
